snippet.description:
Is video me hum Curve Tracing of Cartesian Curves (वक्र अनुरेखण) ko bilkul basic se step-by-step detail me cover karenge. Agar aap BSc Mathematics, B.Tech / Engineering Maths, ya IIT-JAM ki preparation kar rahe hain, toh ye comprehensive lecture aapke liye best guide hai!

Is lecture me hum discuss karenge:

✅ Symmetry (सममिति): x-axis, y-axis, origin aur opposite quadrants ke respect me symmetry kaise check karte hain.
✅ Curve at Origin (मूल बिंदु पर स्थिति): Kya curve origin se pass hota hai? Tangent at origin find karna aur Node, Cusp ya Conjugate points identify karna.
✅ Asymptotes (अनंत स्पर्शियां): Axes ke parallel aur oblique asymptotes nikalna.
✅Intersections with Coordinate Axes (निर्देशांक अक्षों से प्रतिच्छेदन): Intercepts kaise nikalte hain.
✅ Region of Existence (क्षेत्र): x aur y ki real values ka domain decide karna jahan curve exist karta hai.
✅Special Properties: Increasing/decreasing intervals, maxima, minima aur points of inflection.
✅Solved Example: Algebraic curve $xy^2 = 4a^2(2a - x)$ ko step-by-step trace karke Desmos graph ke sath visualize karna.

📌 Timestamps
00:00 – Introduction to Curve Tracing
04:00 – Tracing of Cartesian Curves & Overview
04:42 – Step 1: Symmetry (About X-Axis & Y-Axis)
12:28 – Symmetry About Origin & Opposite Quadrants
16:05 – Symmetry with respect to Lines $y = x$ and $y = -x$
19:18 – Step 2: Position at Origin & Tangents / Singular Points
22:42 – Step 3: Determining Asymptotes (Parallel & Oblique)
23:55 – Step 4: Points of Intersection with Coordinate Axes
27:38 – Step 5: Region of Existence (Real Branches & Domain)
30:02 – Step 6: Special Properties (Monotonicity, Maxima/Minima & Inflection)
33:30 – Summary Checklist & Quick Cubic Example
37:50 – Solved Example: Tracing the Curve $xy^2 = 4a^2(2a - x)$
52:16 – Visualization on Desmos Graphing Calculator
53:05 – Lecture Summary & Conclusion

🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Happy Learning! 📐✨
